title: Module
description: A Module is a feature-area grouping beneath an App and above Workflow/Page — typically the product surface of a sub-Domain or a Process. It groups the Workflows and Pages that realize a business process area.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the module.

description.description: A human-readable explanation of what this module surfaces.

realizes.description: The business node (sub-Domain or Process) this module surfaces, by name.

workflows.description: The Workflows that make up this module. Each entry is the PascalCase name of a Workflow defined in this UI.

items.description: A reference to a Workflow by its PascalCase name.

pages.description: Pages contained directly by this module. Each entry is the PascalCase name of a Page defined in this UI.

items.description: A reference to a Page by its PascalCase name.
